about: The words «что ушло» of a row of the journal (specs/2026-11-14-desk-journal.md JR2.3, Data): every naming of the table JR1.3 and every precision; the readings of a program by the pages of its answer (specs/2026-11-15-desk-mcp.md MC4.4).
